messages:
Sam (AE): Heads up — BlueYonder Health asking for a one-off discounted invoice and net60 payment instead of our standard net30. Invoice #INV-2026-0182 for $72,500. They want 15% off due to procurement timing. Can we approve? @Emma @Arjun
Emma (RevOps): Thanks Sam. Quick Qs: is this for a Dedicated commit or hosted usage? Any risk of creating precedent? :thinking_face:
Sam (AE): It's for a 12-month Dedicated reserved pool (pilot -> scale). Sales says they'll commit to a 3x consumption floor if we grant the concession. Procurement needs net60 to align with their vendor payment cycle.
Arjun (Finance): Policy: single invoice one-off discounts >$10k need Finance lead + RevOps sign-off per https://redwood.internal/pricing-policies#deal-desk. 15% on $72.5k = $10,875, so triggers escalation. Also need to confirm no impact on revenue recognition schedules.
Mike (Sales Ops): We can add an amendment: 15% one-time invoice credit, net60 for first invoice only, future invoices back to net30. Also include a clause for auto-reversion if commitment not met.
Sam (AE): customer confirmed the 3x consumption commit and a signed SOW amendment. They want invoice processed this week to hit their quarter close.
Emma (RevOps): Okay, two things I need: 1) confirmation in writing of the 3x commit (attach SOW or email) and 2) proposed amendment language. If both are present I'm OK to greenlight the discount and net60 for the initial invoice only.
Arjun (Finance): On recognition: we'll need to treat the 15% as a contra-revenue credit tied to that invoice. Confirming accounting treatment with GAAP team — should be fine but will delay recognition until credit applied. Also note our DSO will tick up with net60. Is that acceptable to CFO?
Sam (AE): I'll attach the SOW draft and the procurement email in the thread now.
Sam (AE): Attached: SOW_draft_blueyonder_v1.pdf, procurement-email.png
Emma (RevOps): Reviewing SOW quick. Proposed amendment snippet looks good. Mike, can you draft the exact amendment clause I can sign off on?
Mike (Sales Ops): Drafting now. Proposed clause: ``One-time 15% credit applied to invoice INV-2026-0182. Payment terms for the credited invoice: Net60. All subsequent invoices revert to Net30. If customer fails to meet the 3x consumption commitment within 90 days of the pilot start date, Redwood may invoice the net difference and revoke future credits.``
Emma (RevOps): That reads fine. I approve the one-time 15% credit and Net60 on INV-2026-0182 contingent on signed amendment and SOW in place. Please route to Arjun for accounting entry and to billing for invoice update. :+1:
Arjun (Finance): Received. I'll log the contra-revenue entry and update the AR schedule once billing generates the updated invoice. Please confirm the final invoice amount to post: $72,500 - $10,875 = $61,625.
Sam (AE): Confirmed final amount $61,625. Procurement ok with the wording, they sent signed amendment via DocuSign.
billing-bot: Automated notice — updated invoice generated: INV-2026-0182-v2. Amount: $61,625. Payment terms: Net60. Link: https://billing.redwood.internal/invoices/INV-2026-0182-v2
Arjun (Finance): Noted. I'll mark this as approved in the pricing exceptions tracker and update the monthly cash forecast for the DSO impact.
Emma (RevOps): Thanks everyone. Sam — please add a short note in the CRM about the precedent: one-off credit for procurement-aligned net60; do not treat as standard.
Sam (AE): Will do. Closing the thread once AR confirms receipt of signed amendment. :white_check_mark:
